description: (Rb)₂NaBiI₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Rb clusters inside a NaBiI₆ framework. In each Rb cluster, Rb is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaBiI₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-I bond lengths are 3.14 Å. Bi is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form BiI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Bi-I bond lengths are 3.08 Å. I is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Bi atom.
